Trying with ASan next, though clang + ASan fails and skipping the clang build is currently broken (a few lld / clang deps for llvm-cpu are leaking into a "just vmvx" build).

ah yeah, trace_execution doesn't make it in unfortunately - you can either set `-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-DIREE_VM_EXECUTION_TRACING_FORCE_ENABLE=1` or hack this to true: https://github.com/openxla/iree/blob/main/runtime/src/iree/vm/bytecode/dispatch_util.h#L125

it's also useful if debugging larger programs to set it per-dispatch by ORing `IREE_VM_INVOCATION_FLAG_TRACE_EXECUTION` here: https://github.com/openxla/iree/blob/main/runtime/src/iree/hal/local/loaders/vmvx_module_loader.c#L518
(I usually do that because then I can OR in based on export `ordinal`/workgroup xyz/etc instead of tracing all workgroups from all dispatches which gets hard to read)

Ah, that CMake -> C flags trick is useful!

Here's the output with it set: https://gist.github.com/ScottTodd/1b0753deaa9c58f5265e6ad8b6d5d5d1

The integer args all seem fine, so maybe the `out_ref` buffer is the issue?

issue.body:
GitHub Actions managed runner images look pretty well set up for development already: https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/images/win/Windows2022-Readme.md

We could use Docker to manage other dependencies as needed (CUDA/Vulkan SDK, Python packages, etc.).

I'd probably start with `build_all` and `test_all` from https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml, which make use of these scripts:
* https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/main/build_tools/cmake/build_all.sh
* https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/main/build_tools/cmake/ctest_all.sh

After getting something working, we try larger runners (self-hosted or managed), depending on how slow the builds are.

I don't expect much will be shared between pre/post-submit CI and release builds.
